scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p skeleton/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/dwell-sim-mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/board/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/seance/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:sim: npm run build --workspace=skeleton && npm run build --workspace=tools/dwell-sim-mcp
